context_requirements: Ras-pathway or Rheb/mTOR dependence for antiproliferative response
Wild-type or H/N-Ras rather than K-Ras-driven background for stronger sensitivity
Intact stress and cell-cycle checkpoint machinery
falsifiers: No change in cholesterol biosynthesis genes at 6 h
No proliferation or G2/M gene changes at 24 h
No stress-response gene induction at either time
Uniform strong response across all nine lines

evidence.supports: Farnesyl transferase inhibitor R115777 inhibits growth of many human tumor cell lines and blocks Ras/lamin processing
Farnesyl transferase inhibitor SCH66336 inhibits proliferation and enhances apoptosis in BCR-ABL-positive cells
FTI/GGTI combinations block Ki-Ras prenylation and induce apoptosis in pancreatic tumor cells
Lonafarnib inhibits Rheb farnesylation and mTOR signaling, linking FTI to mTOR-dependent growth
SCH66336 inhibits BCR/ABL transformation, Ras effector pathways, and causes G2/M blockade
